system: civil law system influenced by Dutch civil law

constitution.history: previous 1975; latest ratified 30 September 1987, effective 30 October 1987
constitution.amend: proposed by the National Assembly; passage requires at least two-thirds majority vote of the total membership

courts.highest: High Court of Justice of Suriname (consists of the court president, vice president, and 4 judges)
courts.judges: court judges appointed by the national president in consultation with the National Assembly, the State Advisory Council, and the Order of Private Attorneys; judges serve for life
courts.note: appeals beyond the High Court are referred to the Caribbean Court of Justice; human rights violations can be appealed to the Inter-American Commission on Human Rights with judgments issued by the Inter-American Court on Human Rights

citizenship.descent: at least one parent must be a citizen of Suriname

world: accepts compulsory ICJ jurisdiction with reservations; accepts ICCt jurisdiction

executive.chosen: president and vice president indirectly elected by the National Assembly; president and vice president serve a 5-year term (no term limits)
executive.cabinet: Cabinet of Ministers appointed by the president

b: There are severe penalties for all drug offences. Pack all luggage yourself and do not carry anything through customs for anyone else.

Credit cards are not widely accepted outside major hotels. Check with your hotel whether it accepts credit cards. Some cash machines in Paramaribo will accept international credit and debit cards and dispense Surinamese dollars.
